name: Monthly/Yearly Accordion Archive & Post Filter, Grid Blocks
author: Akshar Addons

sections.description:
Archive Posts, Pages & Categories Accordion helps display WordPress archive content in a responsive accordion layout with AJAX pagination, widgets, shortcode support, and customizable templates.

Visitors can browse posts by month, year, category, tag, or page using an interactive accordion interface designed to improve content discovery and user engagement.

Buy the Premium Version

  • BUY IT NOW!

Premium Version Demo

  • Click Here for a Demo

Get Support

  • Submit a Support Request

Yearly archive shortcode

[archivespostaccordion widget_title="Yearly Archives" date_format="year" number_of_post_display="8" category_id="0" template="pane_style_1"]

Monthly archive shortcode

[archivespostaccordion widget_title="Monthly Archives" date_format="month_year" number_of_post_display="8" category_id="0" template="pane_style_1"]

Free Version Features

  • Ajax based without page refresh loading archive posts.
  • Supports responsive and customizable designs.
  • Five clean and modern templates.
  • Allows to configure unlimited widget for the content area and sidebar.
  • Load next archive posts by ‘load more’ ajax functionality.
  • Design text and background color settings to change styles of the widget heading, month and year, post title.
  • Lightweight and optimized AJAX loading.
  • SEO-friendly archive navigation.

Premium Version Features

  • Load More button
  • Custom Post Type Support
  • Elementor & Gutenberg block support
  • Dynamic Shortcode creation
  • Custom settings available to hide or show post title, cart button, price, animation over image, post image, pagination, post short content and read more link.
  • Dynamic admin settings to change maximum width and height of images.
  • There are three types of ajax based pagination available like load more products, next-previous links and simple numeric pagination.
  • Search functionality by post name and category from the each panel.
  • Supports custom post types.
  • Supports unlimited shortcodes for the content area.
  • Supports accordion list and grid posts views.
  • Allows hide/show post count with each accordion pane.
  • Hide empty categories.
  • 10+ modern templates.
  • Short by or Order by month or year ascending and descending.
  • Hide/Show various categories from accordion panel.
  • Settings to open a month or year accordion pane by default.
  • Supports “All” label accordion pane to load all accordion’s posts.
  • RTL Support.
  • Hide/Show posted date with posts.
  • Hide/Show comments count with posts.
  • Allows to set space between posts items in pixels.
  • Hide/show author image and name.

Support Details

  • We do support for all the plugins and extensions, but please understand that support for premium plugins takes priority.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or upload the extracted trunk folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate “Archive Posts, Pages & Categories Accordion” from the Plugins screen. After activation, WordPress redirects administrators to the plugin’s Archive Accordion help/settings page.
  3. Open Archive Accordion in the WordPress admin menu at any time for shortcode examples, attribute reference, demo, Pro, and support links.
  4. Edit a page or post. In Gutenberg, add a Shortcode block. In a classic editor or supported page builder, add a shortcode element.
  5. Paste one of the examples below and publish/update the page.

sections.faq:
Can I use create widgets?

Yes, Supports multiple accordion widgets.

Can I use shortcodes on pages?

Yes. Add a Shortcode block in Gutenberg or a shortcode element in a compatible page builder. The free version supports the shortcode attributes documented on the Archive Accordion admin page. Some advanced shortcode and custom post type features require Pro.

Can we override or change designing templates and style?

Yes, There is dynamic text and background color selection from admin panel.
